[[Kurzick Necromancer]]s help to defend the gates during the [[Fort Aspenwood]] [[Competitive Mission]]. They are found in front of both inner gates and respawn when [[Raw Amber Chunks]] are given to their respective colored [[gatekeeper]]s. A necromancer also spawns at a command point when its [[Luxon Commander]] is killed.
